name: Marie Antoinette
contribution: Queen of France as the wife of Louis XVI from 10 May 1774 until the abolition of the French monarchy in 1792 during the French Revolution.
image_credit: Élisabeth Louise Vigée Le Brun · Public domain

checks.lead: Marie Antoinette (Maria Antonia Josepha Johanna; 2 November 1755 – 16 October 1793) was Queen of France as the wife of Louis XVI from 10 May 1774 until the abolition of the French monarchy in 1792 during the French Revolution.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
